title: Femcare Ltd Acquires Orion Medical Supplies Ltd in the UK
summary: SALT LAKE CITY, UT / ACCESS Newswire / August 31, 2026 / Femcare Ltd. ("Femcare"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of (Nasdaq:UTMD), announces that it has purchased the entire ordinary share capital of Orion Medical Supplies Ltd ("ORION") of the United Kingdom.
